bullets.text: GitHub Fixes Vulnerability Fast - **GitHub** addressed a critical vulnerability in under six hours, safeguarding millions of repositories.
Giannandrea Joins CuspAI - Former **Apple** AI head, John Giannandrea, is set to aid **CuspAI** in expanding to the US.
YouTube Tests AI Search - **YouTube** is rolling out an AI-powered search feature for guided answers to user queries.
Otter Enhances Enterprise Search - **Otter** introduces a feature allowing users to search across multiple enterprise tools.
Google Translate's New Tool - **Google** introduces a pronunciation feature for **Translate**, enhancing language learning.
Philips Hue's SpatialAware Launch - **Philips Hue** lights now feature SpatialAware for immersive lighting experiences.
Google Wallet Expands ID Support - **Google Wallet** adds support for digital passport IDs from Brazil, Singapore, and Taiwan.
Amazon Offers AI Shopping Q&A - **Amazon** launches an AI-powered audio Q&A feature for product inquiries.
Custom Multiview on YouTube TV - **YouTube TV** introduces customizable multiview for a personalized viewing experience.
Musk's Court Drama Continues - **Elon Musk** testifies in his trial against **OpenAI**, claiming his intent was to save humanity.
